description: This file defines a ProducerProcessor class that filters, transforms, and distributes frames to multiple consumers within a data processing pipeline.

classes.name: ProducerProcessor
classes.description: A class for filtering, transforming, and distributing frames to consumers in a processing pipeline.

methods.name: identity_transformer(frame: Frame)
methods.description: A default async transformer that returns the input frame unchanged.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, filter: Callable[[Frame], Awaitable[bool]], transformer: Callable[[Frame], Awaitable[Frame]] = identity_transformer, passthrough: bool = True, )
methods.description: Initializes the ProducerProcessor with a filter, optional transformer, and passthrough flag.

methods.name: add_consumer(self)
methods.description: Creates and adds a new consumer queue to the processor.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes an incoming frame, applying the filter and optionally transforming and passing it downstream.

methods.name: _produce(self, frame: Frame)
methods.description: Distributes transformed frames to all registered consumers.
